documents.title: Pneumonia - key facts
documents.text: Pneumonia is an acute respiratory infection affecting the lungs. Symptoms may include cough, fever, difficulty breathing. Management depends on severity, age, comorbidities, and suspected pathogen; urgent care is needed for severe symptoms.

documents.title: Chest X-ray findings in pneumonia
documents.text: Common CXR findings in pneumonia include focal or multifocal consolidation, air bronchograms, interstitial opacities, and occasionally pleural effusion. Imaging must be interpreted with clinical context.

documents.title: Brain tumor overview
documents.text: Brain tumors can present with headaches, seizures, focal neurologic deficits, or cognitive changes. MRI findings vary by tumor type. Any suspicion requires urgent specialist review; imaging AI is assistive, not diagnostic.
